name: chess-training
description: Chess training game with puzzles and AI opponents

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../electron && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "API,WEB,APP" --prefix-colors "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron: cd electron && npx tsc && NODE_ENV=development npx electron .
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit && npx vite build
scripts.build:prod: npm run build && cd frontend && npx vite build --emptyOutDir
scripts.test: cd backend && echo "No tests yet" && cd ../frontend && npx vitest run
